conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: A vista tree candidate is sampled for height at local plus LOD origin, while its current instanced position is supplied as local and the instanced shader treats it as world space.
conditional_findings.trace: spawn_vista_trees computes local candidate, then world=local+lod origin for tree_root_height. After a successful height query it stores ChunkInstance.position=(local.x,height,local.y). VistaCardBatches passes that instance into InstanceBatch; the shared WGSL builds its world matrix from i_pos_scale.xyz, and the chunk entity transform is documented as CPU culling only. In contrast ActiveVistaSurface.present_chunk assigns mesh Transform from lod origin. For any produced candidate with local east20m and origin east100m, the height input is east120m and the instance source position east20m, a 100m frame difference if all selection and sampling conditions succeed. Historical6533 used per-entity Transform from the same local coordinates; this is not attributed solely to the batching change.

conditional_findings.canonical_owner: Vista tree card angular-size admission and its camera-distance metric across per-card and batched presentation.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: The historical per-entity near gate uses Bevy VisibilityRange distance to the entity origin in three dimensions, whereas the current instanced fragment shader applies its near cutoff using horizontal distance to the fragment.
conditional_findings.trace: At6533 each card carried vista_tree_visibility with use_aabb=false, near start scaled by card height divided by2*tan(8 degrees), and a12% fade. Both6533 and95e Cargo.lock pin bevy_camera0.19.1; its selected source computes length(view position minus entity translation) and admits distances within VisibilityRange. At95e a batch has a far visibility band, while the instance shader computes the near cutoff from card height and scale but discards when distance(view.world_position.xz, fragment.world_position.xz) is below it. For a hypothetical10m card at scale1, cutoff is about35.6m; a camera50m above and20m horizontally from its root is about53.9m away in3D, beyond the historical near fade, while a fragment at the root XZ is20m away horizontally and fails the new near gate.
conditional_findings.safeguards: The arithmetic compares source predicates and pinned native source only.
